book.title: Computer Architecture: A Quantitative Approach
book.authors: John L. Hennessy & David A. Patterson

chapters.title: Fundamentals of Quantitative Design and Analysis
chapters.summary: Performance equations, Amdahl's Law, energy and power, integrated circuit costs, dependability, benchmarks. The toolkit you use to argue about design tradeoffs in every later chapter.

chapters.title: Memory Hierarchy Design
chapters.summary: Ten advanced cache optimizations, virtual memory, virtual machines, SRAM/DRAM/Flash technology. The most interview-frequent topic — you will be asked about caches.

chapters.title: Instruction-Level Parallelism and Its Exploitation
chapters.summary: Branch prediction, dynamic scheduling (Tomasulo), speculation, multiple issue, multithreading. The deep-dive chapter for OoO superscalar concepts — pairs perfectly with Shen & Lipasti.

chapters.title: Data-Level Parallelism in Vector, SIMD, and GPU Architectures
chapters.summary: Vector processors, SIMD instruction set extensions (SSE/AVX/NEON), GPU architecture (NVIDIA Fermi). The new chapter that demystifies GPUs using traditional architecture terminology.

chapters.title: Thread-Level Parallelism
chapters.summary: Multicore, symmetric (SMP) vs distributed shared memory, cache coherence (snooping & directory), synchronization primitives, memory consistency models.

chapters.title: Warehouse-Scale Computers to Exploit Request-Level and Data-Level Parallelism
chapters.summary: WSC architecture, MapReduce, cloud computing economics, networking, power, real Google datacenter walkthrough. New for the 5th edition.

chapters.title: Appendix A: Instruction Set Principles
chapters.summary: ISA classification, addressing modes, operand encoding, MIPS64. The reference for any RISC vs CISC question.

chapters.title: Appendix B: Review of Memory Hierarchy
chapters.summary: Cache fundamentals tutorial — the basics before Chapter 2's advanced material. Read first if caches feel rusty.

chapters.title: Appendix C: Pipelining: Basic and Intermediate Concepts
chapters.summary: 5-stage MIPS pipeline, hazards (structural, data, control), forwarding, branches, multicycle operations. Foundation for Chapter 3.
key_concepts: 5-stage MIPS pipeline (IF, ID, EX, MEM, WB)
